title: Workers AI token rates derived from Cloudflare's published Neuron table

source.freeAllocationNote: The daily free allocation is an account-level discount on Cloudflare's invoice. It is not part of any per-call rate, so governed rates price every Neuron.

derivation: microusd per million tokens = neurons per million tokens x 11, because $0.011 per 1,000 Neurons is exactly 11 USD micros per Neuron. Cached input uses the listed cached-input Neurons, or the input Neurons when Cloudflare lists no cached price. Cloudflare has no cache-write charge, so cache-write tokens are priced as input.

models.note: Same-start correction of the current token-list rate (950000 / 190000 / 4000000, cache write 0). Neuron-exact values differ by at most 0.0005%; the correction records the Neuron basis and prices cache writes as input.

No governed rate in the current account scope; calls were priced from AI Gateway's reported cost, which matches these Neurons exactly for 5-19 Nov 2026 (13,550,335 input + 937,819 output tokens = $6.0877).
The pricing page has no row named -fast; the -fp8-fast row is used. AI Gateway's reported cost for 5-19 Nov 2026 matches it exactly (1,598,965 input + 74,081 output tokens = $0.1009).

reconciliation.window: 2026-11-06..2026-11-17 (UTC charge days present in Cloudflare billable usage for the current account)
reconciliation.ledgerNeuronsNote: All Workers AI calls in tedi_call_costs (every model above except clef-flash), recomputed from their input, cached-input and output tokens with these Neuron rows. Within 0.07% of Cloudflare.
reconciliation.billedUsdNote: Cloudflare's $101.11 is 9.19M billable Neurons x $0.011 / 1,000, after the free allocation; 6 Nov shows 224,356 Neurons billed at $0.
reconciliation.gapExplanation: The ledger's larger 5-19 Nov total is not over-counting. Cloudflare's billable usage has no 5 Nov row for this account and had not yet posted 18-19 Nov ($98.85 in the ledger) when the $101.11 was read.
